documentation_excerpts.text: Guide to find the open PR for the current branch and address its comments with gh CLI. Run all `gh` commands with elevated network access.
## 1) Inspect comments needing attention - Run scripts/fetch_comments.py which will print out all the comments and review threads on the PR

## 2) Ask the user for clarification - Number all the review threads and comments and provide a short summary of what would be required to apply a fix for it - Ask the user which numbered comments should be addressed
